mechanism.name: Script-Proved Ingress-Connected Portal Graph
mechanism.description: SCIL localizes a requested-entity proof carrier; the unchanged structural portal proposer supplies raw candidate regions; a frozen ADE20K semantic graph attaches that proof only to candidates below the carrier that contain functional ingress pixels and intersect the same connected host component.
mechanism.single_structural_change: Replace prior direct door-class, object-state, and frame-global proof attachment with an explicit entity-anchor -> semantic-host-component -> walkable-ingress-candidate ownership graph. The graph transports identity spatially; neither generic portal shape nor semantic walkability alone can name the target.
mechanism.information_source_change: The new information is localized script proof plus broad-domain scene topology and ingress semantics. No PB1-PB17 matcher threshold, seed, backbone, detector prompt, crop, tracker, morphology, fusion-weight, or source-label sweep is reopened.

source_receipts.freshness: Eight entity names, Chinese aliases, and exact filenames had zero hits in PB1-PB17 active sources and local named-poi manifests. Roles and all human target/tenant boxes were frozen on downloaded source pixels before any PB18 OCR, semantic, or proposer call.

scil.authority: PB4 Development-selected SCIL thresholds copied exactly and applied once to the eight fresh candidate profiles as a single pack.
scil.localized_carrier_rule: Enumerate contiguous OCR spans of length one through four and retain the strongest target-specific, conflict-free SCIL carrier by frozen lexicographic order. This localizes already-frozen SCIL evidence; it does not change the global proof thresholds.
scil.proof_rule: Only a correct, conflict-free global proof meeting both thresholds may carry target authority. UNKNOWN and wrong proofs authorize no portal.

graph.development_authority: One discrete rule was selected on the already-consumed PB7 cohort. It produced target-portal Top1 6/6, Top3 6/6, no-portal false authorization 0/2, and balanced accuracy 1.0. The smallest retained positive ingress fraction was 0.04310344827586207; the largest no-portal proposal fraction was 0.0018263561320754718. The fixed 0.01 threshold lies between them and is not swept on PB18.
graph.host_rule: Union the frozen host classes, form raw eight-connected components, choose the component with maximum overlap with the localized SCIL carrier, or the nearest host pixel if the carrier itself has no host pixels.
graph.candidate_rule: In unchanged portal-proposer rank order, retain a candidate only when its center is not above the SCIL carrier center, at least 1% of its semantic crop is an ingress class, and at least one crop pixel belongs to the selected host component. Authorize the first three retained candidates only after correct SCIL proof.
graph.truth_membership: A proposal is a target or tenant-decoy member when its center lies inside the corresponding frozen human box and at least half of its own area lies inside that box.
graph.forbidden_processing: No source-dependent threshold, class, connectivity, rank, candidate count, morphology, crop, OCR alias, detector, prompt, tracker, or fusion change after this protocol.

cohort.negative_definition: The two no-portal frames contribute frame-level rejection opportunities. The two decoy frames contribute only the explicitly frozen tenant-portal regions as negative opportunities; each also contains a positive target-building portal.

metrics: SCIL correct proof, wrong proof, and UNKNOWN counts
target-building portal Top1 and Top3 membership across all six target-portal frames
false authorization on two identity-visible no-portal frames
tenant-decoy overlap authorization on two same-frame ownership controls
exact target-hit and tenant-reject ownership pairs
opportunity-balanced Top3 accuracy over six positive portal opportunities and four negative no-portal-or-tenant opportunities

promotion_gate.identity: 8/8 correct SCIL proofs, zero wrong, zero UNKNOWN.
promotion_gate.tenant_ownership: 0/2 tenant-decoy overlap authorizations and 2/2 exact target-hit plus tenant-reject pairs.
promotion_gate.aggregate: Opportunity-balanced Top3 accuracy must equal 1.0; all evaluator gate clauses are conjunctive.

stop_rule: Run exactly once to the absent frozen output. After output, do not alter source files, aliases, roles, human boxes, SCIL thresholds, semantic model/classes, host rule, ingress threshold, candidate rule, membership, rank limit, metrics, or gate on these rows. A failure closes this representation on PB18 rather than triggering a rescue sweep.

next_step.gate_met: Retain SP-ICPG as conditional current-frame entity-bound portal-set proposal authority. The next new source must measure issued action -> changed active view -> retained/reacquired target portal; do not claim guidance or HANDOFF_READY from PB18.
next_step.gate_not_met: Close this graph on PB18 and move to an external entity-owned entrance-node plus posed panorama ray source, which changes the information modality rather than tuning this cohort.

claim_boundary: A pass is fresh, entity/file-disjoint evidence that localized script identity, broad scene topology, and functional ingress semantics can bind a current-frame target portal set while rejecting same-frame tenant portals on this opportunity-stratified cohort. It does not establish natural prevalence, legal/public access, traversability, active-view causality, temporal persistence, directional guidance, metric arrival, HANDOFF_READY, completion, product benefit, user benefit, or safety.
